blueprint_topic: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies — NPH insulin resuspension and appearance
stem: Before drawing a dose from a HUMULIN N vial, the nurse gently rolls the vial between the palms 10 times and carefully inverts it 10 times. Which appearance indicates the insulin is ready for use?

options.A: The insulin is uniformly white and cloudy without visible lumps or particles after mixing.
options.B: The insulin is completely clear after mixing, with no cloudiness remaining in the vial.
options.C: The insulin contains small white clumps after mixing because particulate material is expected in NPH insulin.
options.D: The insulin separates into distinct clear and cloudy layers immediately after mixing and remains visibly layered.

rationale: Current HUMULIN N Instructions for Use direct gently rolling the vial at least 10 times and carefully inverting it at least 10 times. After mixing, HUMULIN N should look white and cloudy; it should not be used if it looks clear or contains lumps or particles. Therefore A is correct. B, C, and D describe appearances inconsistent with the labeled instructions.
educational_objective: Prepare NPH insulin by gentle rolling and inversion and verify a uniformly white, cloudy suspension without lumps or particles before administration.
source_organization: DailyMed (U.S. National Library of Medicine); Eli Lilly and Company
source_document_title: HUMULIN N (insulin human) injection, suspension — Instructions for Use
source_locator: Vial Instructions for Use, Preparing your HUMULIN N dose, Steps 1–2: gently roll at least 10 times, carefully invert at least 10 times; should look white and cloudy after mixing; do not use if clear or if lumps/particles are present.
source_claim_supported: Properly mixed HUMULIN N is white and cloudy and should not contain lumps or particles.
blueprint_locator: Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies: prepare and administer medications safely, review medication appearance and administration requirements, and handle high-risk medications safely.
candidate_reasons_resolved: Removed isolated absolute-word distractor pattern and rewrote all options as comparable visual assessments.
Anchored exact resuspension technique and appearance to current FDA-approved Instructions for Use.
audit_note: Independent adversarial review confirms A uniquely matches the current HUMULIN N Instructions for Use. Clear appearance, lumps/particles, or persistent visible layering are not the labeled ready-to-use appearance.
